novel_policies.label: business law course hours
novel_policies.quote: complete a five-hour business and law course that: is taught by an approved pre-licensure course provider

novel_policies.label: financial responsibility demonstration methods
novel_policies.quote: Before issuing, renewing, or reinstating a contractor license, the division shall require an applicant to demonstrate financial responsibility by: completing a financial responsibility questionnaire the division prepares; and signing the questionnaire and certifying the accuracy of the information provided; or submitting a bond in the form and amount the commission determines by rule

novel_policies.label: gas appliance certification required
novel_policies.quote: Any person described in Subsection (2)(b) that performs work described in Subsection (2)(a): must first receive training and certification as specified in rules adopted by the commission

novel_policies.label: hvac continuing education topic hours minimum
novel_policies.quote: For an HVAC contractor, at least three of the six required continuing education hours must directly relate to the installation, repair, or replacement of heating, ventilation, or air conditioning systems.

novel_policies.label: hvac exempt from small project exemption
novel_policies.quote: does not involve the installation, repair, or replacement of a heating, ventilation, or air conditioning system

novel_policies.label: hvac specific experience required
novel_policies.quote: An applicant for licensure as an HVAC contractor shall produce satisfactory evidence to the division that the applicant: completed two years full-time paid employment of HVAC specific experience.

novel_policies.label: hvac specific experience years
novel_policies.quote: completed two years full-time paid employment of HVAC specific experience

novel_policies.label: license number on permits required
novel_policies.quote: The division shall require the contractor's license number on permit applications, contracts, agreements, or bids that require a license.

novel_policies.label: degree level: bachelor
novel_policies.quote: Has received a baccalaureate degree from an accredited 4-year college in the appropriate field of engineering, architecture, or building construction and has 1 year of proven experience in the category in which the person seeks to qualify.

novel_policies.label: does not require moral character
novel_policies.quote: no specialty section of the board shall adopt, maintain, renew, or enforce any rule, or otherwise preclude in any way, an individual from renewing a license under this chapter due to any past criminal activity or interpretation of moral character.

novel_policies.label: natural gas facilities installation authorized
novel_policies.quote: 'Qualifying installer' means a person who: a gas corporation approves to install natural gas facilities; and is: licensed under this chapter; and authorized to install natural gas facilities within the person's scope of practice as established by statute or administrative rule.

novel_policies.label: prelicensure course hours
novel_policies.quote: complete a 25-hour pre-licensure course that: is taught by an approved pre-licensure course provider

novel_policies.label: does not authorize natural gas facilities installation
novel_policies.quote: The scope of work for such contractor also includes any excavation work incidental thereto, but does not include any work such as liquefied petroleum or natural gas fuel lines within buildings, except for disconnecting or reconnecting changeouts of liquefied petroleum or natural gas appliances within buildings

novel_policies.label: public liability insurance required
novel_policies.quote: proof of public liability insurance in the coverage amounts and form the division makes by rule in accordance with Title 63G, Chapter 3, Utah Administrative Rulemaking Act

novel_policies.label: qualifier cessation notification days
novel_policies.quote: the contractor shall notify the division in writing within 10 days after the day on which the association ceases.

novel_policies.label: qualifier license type required
novel_policies.quote: An applicant for licensure as an HVAC contractor shall submit to the division satisfactory evidence that the applicant: completed two-years' full-time, paid employment requiring HVAC specific experience; and passed an examination

novel_policies.label: qualifier replacement grace period days
novel_policies.quote: If notice is given, the contractor's license shall remain in force for 60 days after the day on which the association ceases.

novel_policies.label: qualifier required
novel_policies.quote: The division shall require a contractor to have a qualifier.

novel_policies.label: scope expansion by rule authorized
novel_policies.quote: 'HVAC contractor' means a person licensed under this chapter specialized in the installation, maintenance, repair, and servicing of heating, ventilation, air conditioning systems or any other work the division authorizes by rule in accordance with Subsection 58-55-301(4).

novel_policies.label: small project exemption threshold dollars
novel_policies.quote: subject to Subsection (3), a person working on a project that has a total cost of less than $7,000 including labor, material, and changes to the agreed upon work

novel_policies.label: system components included
novel_policies.quote: 'HVAC' means a heating, ventilation, and air conditioning system and the specific components that are a part of the system, including the gas line.

novel_policies.label: workers compensation insurance required
novel_policies.quote: Before the division issues a license, the applicant shall file with the division: proof of workers' compensation insurance covering the applicant's employees

novel_policies.label: has advisory board
novel_policies.quote: There is hereby established the Committee of Mechanical Examiners

novel_policies.label: does not require bonding
novel_policies.quote: As a prerequisite to the initial issuance or the renewal of a certificate or registration, the applicant shall submit an affidavit on a form provided by the board attesting to the fact that the applicant has obtained workers' compensation insurance as required by chapter 440, public liability insurance, and property damage insurance

novel_policies.label: does not require continuing education
novel_policies.quote: Establish by board rule a maximum of four (4) hours per year of continuing education if the board determines that a specific class of license requires continuing education

novel_policies.label: uses a registration credential
novel_policies.quote: Issue and deliver to the applicant a certificate of registration as a mechanical contractor

novel_policies.label: does not offer reciprocity
novel_policies.quote: Within (1) one year of the date the Governor of this state declares a state of emergency in response to a disaster involving the destruction of dwelling units, the Construction Industries Board shall issue a distinctively colored, nonrenewable, temporary mechanical journeyman license which shall expire one (1) year after the date of declaration to any person who is currently licensed as a mechanical journeyman by another state

novel_policies.label: regulates by registration
novel_policies.quote: Issue and deliver to the applicant a certificate of registration as a mechanical contractor

novel_policies.label: lacks title protection
novel_policies.quote: No person shall offer to perform services for which a license issued by the commissioner is required unless the person holds an active license to perform those services.

novel_policies.label: houses oversight in a standalone board
novel_policies.quote: The authority of the board is expanded to allow the board to examine, certify, and regulate heating, air conditioning, and refrigeration on a statewide basis.

novel_policies.label: houses oversight in a division
novel_policies.quote: There is created within the Division of Consumer Affairs in the Department of Law and Public Safety the State Board of Examiners of Heating, Ventilating, Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Contractors.

novel_policies.quote: "department" means the Department of Commerce, Community, and Economic Development except where the context otherwise requires
